title: Brand release passes regression and Vercel build checks
summary: Validated preserved production source plus the 30-brand catalogue before GitHub publication and domain promotion.

changes.detail: Restored the two omitted learning modules used by regression tests; no existing production application behavior was changed during this continuation.

validation.name: Regression
validation.detail: 633 tests passed, zero failed, five skipped. Android back-controller (10 scenarios) and scroll-return scenarios passed. Local noVNC tests used the existing learning-app dependency installation.

validation.name: TypeScript and archive
validation.detail: tsc --noEmit passed. History check preserved all 522 reports. git diff --check passed.

validation.name: Production build
validation.detail: Vercel deployment dpl_Anin3iKdC7zzVkntYRKohWud7K6A is READY. Compilation, type validation, course validation and all 258 static pages passed. Existing lint warnings remain.

validation.name: Protected deployment API
validation.detail: Authenticated vercel curl returned 30 brands from /api/products/brands. Direct unauthenticated deployment checks reached Vercel login and are not considered page validation.

validation.name: Source secret checks
validation.detail: Mobile source audit checked 184 files with no findings; changed-file private-key/token pattern scan found no matches. No mobile bundle was audited.

validation.name: Remaining acceptance checks
validation.detail: Domain promotion and live HTTP checks pending. No connected browser: visual, authenticated admin saving, payment completion and physical Expo device acceptance remain untested. No Expo binary or OTA publication is included.
